name: What factors determine the cost of a garage remodel?

mainEntity.name: What factors determine the cost of a garage remodel?

acceptedAnswer.text: Cost depends primarily on the current condition of the structure and the planned end use. A cosmetic garage refresh—addressing drywall patches, painting walls, and installing trim—sits at the lower end of the budget. Transforming an unfinished space into a functional workshop or finished bonus room costs more due to framing, insulation, drywall finishing, and trade rough-ins. Before requesting estimates, decide whether you need specialized lighting, a utility sink, or built-in cabinetry, as coordinating plumbing and electrical trades alongside finish carpentry directly shapes overall project pricing.
acceptedAnswer.description: Costs depend on square footage, framing additions, insulation, drywall work, finish carpentry, and whether plumbing or electrical trade coordination is required.
